our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is exhaustion of available cash sufficient to prevent OpenAI from paying obligations when due.
Accounting losses, cash burn, large commitments, fundraising, or a disputed payment do not alone establish cash exhaustion.
The cash-exhaustion forecast is firm; the coincidence with difficult fundraising is qualified by 'likely'.
The currency is read as U.S. dollars from the company and surrounding dollar-denominated commitments. No accounting basis or forecast date is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records establish that OpenAI becomes unable to pay due obligations because available cash has been exhausted. Assess the qualified fundraising-timing clause separately if such an event occurs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period of continued solvency disproves an indefinite eventual forecast. Contradiction would require a definitive end to the relevant company's obligations with all obligations paid and no qualifying cash-exhaustion event.
